Apple chip:       Apple M3 Pro
Chip family/SKU (policy):  3 pro
Memory:           16 GiB
Memory tier:      workstation (physical standard)
Thermal class:    cooled
Throughput class: fast
Default video:    prince-canuma/LTX-2-distilled
Family:           ltx2
Size:             512x512
Frames:           33
Steps:            pipeline default
Generate:         allowed

fit is default (composed choice), fits, tight (measure first), or poor for this Mac.
cached is yes for Wan when models/video/wan21-t2v-1.3b-q4 has config.json,
model.safetensors, t5_encoder.safetensors, and vae.safetensors. LTX is cached when
the distilled snapshot has every transformer, text-encoder, and VAE-decoder shard,
text projections, and a spatial x2 upscaler. Nothing is downloaded.

fit	cached	model	weights	use
fits	yes	wan21-t2v-1.3b-q4	UMT5 encoder ~11 GB	Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B 4-bit; convert once with make prepare-video
default	no	prince-canuma/LTX-2-distilled	distilled, 36 GB+	Quality path on cooled 36 GB and up

One clip at a time: make video VIDEO_PROMPT="..."
Wan convert (once): make prepare-video
